matrix_role: tests for voter registration, ballot access, mail and custody, accessibility, UOCAVA, provisional cure, tabulation, audit, canvass, certification, recount, contest, election security, and public-result continuity claims

EC-01.fail_or_repair: Open an eligibility and registration-state docket before citing registration status as voting access.
EC-01.label: Eligibility and registration-state continuity
EC-01.question: Does the packet distinguish legal eligibility, registration route, active/inactive status, address, precinct, challenge, restoration, and voter-facing verification before treating a status row as suffrage?

EC-02.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a ballot request or polling-place lookup as ballot access until ballot style and channel are verified.
EC-02.label: Ballot style and channel entitlement
EC-02.question: Can the packet prove the voter had the correct ballot style, district, party where relevant, language, accessible format, and channel route?

EC-03.fail_or_repair: Build a mail/custody clock and downgrade any claim that asks a scan or postmark to prove more than it can prove.
EC-03.label: Mail, postmark, drop-box, and custody clock
EC-03.question: Does the packet separate ballot issue, delivery, voter return, postal possession or postmark evidence, election-office receipt, signature/ID review, cure, acceptance, and counting?

EC-04.fail_or_repair: Treat polling-place operations as incomplete until degraded-mode voting and reconciliation are shown.
EC-04.label: Polling-place, e-pollbook, and degraded-mode proof
pass_evidence: paper pollbook or emergency ballot route
EC-04.question: If check-in, ballot-on-demand, vote center, equipment, power, network, staffing, or line management fails, is there a paper, emergency, staffing, or extension route?

EC-05.fail_or_repair: Do not accept an accessible-machine checkbox as proof of accessible voting.
EC-05.label: Whole-process accessibility
EC-05.question: Is access proven across registration, websites/apps, mail ballot applications, polling places, drop boxes, ballot marking, communication, assistance, privacy, and independence?

EC-06.fail_or_repair: Open a cure ledger; do not treat provisional envelopes as suffrage protection without notice, proof, and outcome.
EC-06.label: Provisional, challenge, and cure ledger
EC-06.question: Are provisional, signature, ID, eligibility, address, and challenge ballots tracked by reason, notice, proof route, deadline, outcome, and public denominator?

EC-07.fail_or_repair: Separate UOCAVA voters from domestic aggregate metrics when timing or transmission risk is live.
EC-07.label: UOCAVA and remote-voter deadline lane
EC-07.question: For military and overseas voters, are ballot-transmission date, allowed return methods, FWAB/emergency route, receipt, cure, and counting outcome visible?

EC-08.fail_or_repair: Do not treat unofficial results or certification as complete until audit, recount, contest, and discrepancy boundaries are visible.
EC-08.label: Tabulation, audit, canvass, recount, and certification ladder
EC-08.question: Does the packet separate unofficial result, tabulation, adjudication, reconciliation, audit, canvass, certification, recount, contest, and finality boundary?

EC-09.fail_or_repair: Publish a source-of-truth map and downgrade third-party summaries or result dashboards that omit authority and finality labels.
EC-09.label: Official source-of-truth and public communication
EC-09.question: Can voters and observers tell which official source answers registration, ballot tracking, polling place, accessibility, results, meetings, certification, and correction questions?

EC-10.fail_or_repair: Join security evidence to election function and degraded mode before citing resilience or public confidence.
EC-10.label: Cyber, vendor, and physical-security dependency
EC-10.question: Are election-management, voting-system, e-pollbook, website, reporting-feed, vendor-access, DDoS, ransomware, physical-security, and intimidation risks joined to voting-continuity fallback routes?
